checks.finding: Conditional on fixed A,W,y, E[B|A,W,y]=0 gives E[Z]=z0, so integrable cross-entropy satisfies Jensen. Strict convexity on logits modulo span{1} makes equality equivalent to AB being class-common almost surely. Label independence alone does not establish the conditional-mean premise.

The supplied implementation gives A(xi)=xi A_a and update(xi)=xi A_a/sqrt(1+xi^2||A_a||_F^2), hence update'(0)=A_a. Writing the aggregate as xi times the attention average of a, exponential Fréchet differentiation and quotient differentiation give z_c'(0)=f_a,c and z_c''(0)=2 eta tr[A_a M_E(A_a)]/D. The global trace normalization cancels; the smooth Frobenius normalization introduces no additional second-order logit term.

The two token states and all forty query states are normalized in C^8 and satisfy the stated measured_attention interface. With beta_y=0 and each other bias log(9/39), the zero-utility softmax has p_y=1/10. All forty identical utility rows have exactly zero mathematical class-centered utility.

Both query types have D=(1+2 epsilon)/(1+8 epsilon). The balanced query has f_a,y=0 and purely off-diagonal A_a in its query eigenbasis, yielding K_y=2/[(1+2 epsilon)L]. Other queries have f_a,o=r and commuting A_a, yielding K_o=1-r^2=4 epsilon(1+epsilon)/(1+2 epsilon)^2.

At zero, the logit derivatives are 0 for y and r for every other class. Their softmax variance is p(1-p)r^2, while the acceleration contribution is 2 eta(1-p)(K_o-K_y). Thus ell_y''(0)=(1-p)[p r^2+2 eta(K_o-K_y)], as claimed.

At epsilon=1e-6 and eta=1, r^2<1, K_o<1/100000, L<16 and 1+2 epsilon<9/8 imply K_y>1/9. Consequently the bracket is below 1/10+1/50000-2/9<0. The stated exponential bound establishes L<16 without numerical execution.

The finite-dimensional exponential and positive attention denominator make the path smooth near zero. Symmetric Taylor expansion therefore gives strictly lower expected uncentered-full CE for sufficiently small nonzero h. Both centered readouts remain at beta, so centering strictly increases CE for this fixed-parameter, symmetric-sign example.

Zero centered construction makes construction_only use E0 routing, giving positive curvature p(1-p)r^2. The same formula holds for fixed native routing defined by E0. Centered_native is flat regardless of its routing because its readout utilities vanish. The actual imported legacy native implementation is not included, so its identification with E0 routing is not independently source-verified here.

Choosing a fixed model whose distinguished class is also the fixed example label is legitimate for an existence counterexample. Neither supplied forward update receives y, and an independent symmetric sign has zero mean. No prediction-time label access is required.

The result concerns accepted function-interface states and fixed model parameters, not raw-circuit reachability, retrained optima or dataset performance. The curvature threshold is specific to this geometry. Established Jensen and matrix-exponential identities do not establish novelty or L5.

risks: The imported legacy implementation, including its EPS definition and native attention formula, was not supplied. The numerical epsilon is taken as the explicitly stipulated premise; the native curvature statement is verified for the stated E0 fixed routes.
The counterexample establishes interface compatibility, not joint reachability of these states, queries and utilities from the original raw-input circuit.
The strict finite-amplitude conclusion is local and existential; no explicit admissible h or floating-point validation is established.
External literature contents, source hashes and empirical history were not independently authenticated. No literature-priority conclusion follows.
accepted_claim: At the stipulated epsilon=1e-6, eta=1 and forty-class measured_attention interface, the supplied construction rigorously exhibits negative local CE curvature along a zero-mean common utility direction. For sufficiently small symmetric amplitudes, removing that direction strictly worsens expected CE at fixed parameters. Fixed-route Jensen remains valid under its conditional-mean assumption but does not justify centering through the nonlinear routing map.
